title: Into The Deep v1.4 (Jan 3, 2026)
description: The one surviving saved copy of Into The Deep, at version 1.4: a floor-by-floor extraction game with an inventory, traders, spells and shields - gold marks trader gear, and dying costs your loadout. Earlier versions are lost, but the release story survives: 1.0 and 1.2 both landed November 21, 1.3 on December 2, and 1.4 here on January 3.
